title: The Marfa Lights Phenomenon
hook: Nobody has explained why lights dance over Marfa's desert
headline: The Desert Lights That Defy Science

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: First recorded sighting was by rancher Robert Reed Ellison (sometimes called Brown) in 1883 near Marfa.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: In 1953 a military unit documented glowing orbs moving erratically during a night patrol.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: UT researchers recorded numerous sightings over several decades, noting colors ranging from red to white.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: A 2015 infrared study reported no heat signatures, suggesting the lights may be optical reflections.

end.line: What could cause lights to appear without any measurable heat?

description: Explore the baffling Marfa Lights and the puzzling evidence behind them.

facts.claim: Rancher Robert Brown reported a light near Marfa in 1883
The US Army documented glowing orbs in 1953 during a night patrol
University of Texas researchers recorded about 200 sightings between 1970 and 1990
A 2015 infrared study found no heat signatures from the Marfa Lights
